items.energy_text: You can earn +1 energy by watching a video.
items.tut_select_paper: Select a wrapping paper to start wrapping flowers.
items.tut_flower_explanation: A good bouquet has a variety of flowers. Your first order is 2 gypsophilas. Do not add more than necessary. Remember each flowers costs money.
items.tut_flower_place: Tap on the wrapping paper to place the flowers.
items.tut_use_scissor: Use the scissors to cut the stems of the flowers.
items.tut_place_machine: Place the bouquet on the wrapping machine to start wrapping.
items.tut_machine_intro: This is the wrapping machine. It wraps the bouquet with a paper.
items.tut_place_ribbon: Place a ribbon on the bouquet to finish wrapping.
items.tut_select_ribbon: Select a ribbon to wrap the bouquet.
items.tut_new_item_explanation: You can buy new items from the shop. Let's buy Red Rose.
items.tut_next_day: You can continue to the next day by clicking the Next Day button.
items.privacy_text:
Can we use your data to tailor ads for you?

Our partners will collect data and use mobile identifiers for ad personalisation and measurement.
